metadata.description: ITL (decode step time) vs batch size and KV tokens per request, from EXP-16 InstrumentedScheduler step dumps (stock FIFO, fixed 8192-token budget). Measured cells are per-cell medians of decode-only steps; modelled cells fill the grid so the Go bilinear lookup always finds four corners. tokens_per_request is the logical KV count, inflated by prefix cache sharing -- the same quantity Llumnix queries with.
